name: Camarilla pivot breakout state: close > R1 long, close < S1 short
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: Using previous daily bar: range = high-low; R1 = close + range x 1.1/12 (R3: 1.1/4, R4: 1.1/2); S levels mirrored. Long state when close > chosen R level (default R1).
entry_short: close < S1 (default) from previous daily Camarilla levels; optional reverse mode inverts both.
exit: Flat or reversed: position flips to short when close < chosen S level (default S1); close_all when state is 0 (only before first signal).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Buy/sell levels selectable R1-R5/S1-S5; the strategy is always-in-market after first signal (stop-and-reverse). Camarilla R5/S5 formulas in script.
